label: ◎ URDF: Open 3D Preview
args: PORT_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/zed-urdf-visualizer-${USER:-default}.port"; if [ -f "$PORT_FILE" ]; then curl --noproxy '*' -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$PORT_FILE")/api/open-preview" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"file_path\":\"$ZED_FILE\",\"browser\":false}" >/dev/null; else echo 'urdf-lsp is not running for this Xacro file yet'; fi

label: ↗ URDF: Open 3D Preview in Browser
args: PORT_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/zed-urdf-visualizer-${USER:-default}.port"; if [ -f "$PORT_FILE" ]; then curl --noproxy '*' -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$PORT_FILE")/api/open-preview" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"file_path\":\"$ZED_FILE\",\"browser\":true}" >/dev/null; else echo 'urdf-lsp is not running for this Xacro file yet'; fi
